fields.acceptance: A web package test renders the layout and each partial with fixture data and compares the HTML with golden files regenerated by -update.
fields.statement: The shared layout (header with daemon pill and live indicator, nav to Overview, Runs and Roadmap) and the partials every page uses (panel with kicker, status pill per run and change set state, dense row whose title is its link and which shows no ID, typed node glyph, step timeline whose sessions show no ID, always-dark terminal block, empty and stale states) render from the design system.
